 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Stack the third colored sample object immediately above the lower color-1 shape."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    # The bottom half is the result canvas; preserve its existing pattern.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[divider + 1:]]
    # Select the colored object in the examples besides the fixed color-1 and color-2 samples.
    target_colors = {v for row in grid[:divider] for v in row if v not in (0, 1, 2, 5)}
    color = min(target_colors)
    pixels = [(r, c) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    minr = min(r for r, c in pixels)
    maxr = max(r for r, c in pixels)
    minc = min(c for r, c in pixels)
    maxc = max(c for r, c in pixels)
    shape = [(r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in pixels]
    bottom = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    bottom_top = min(r for r, c in bottom)
    bottom_left = min(c for r, c in bottom)
    top = bottom_top - (maxr - minr + 1)
    for dr, dc in shape:
        rr, cc = top + dr, bottom_left + dc
        if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < w:
            out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
"
